Name: Octopus Plushies - AT
Author: skellady
Description:
[size=3]This mod adds 16 octopus plushies through Alternative Textures. 

[/size][size=3]Placing the objects/paintings will randomly pick one of the textures, however, if you'd like to set a specific texture, you'd need to buy the Paint Bucket Tool (added by AT) at Robin's shop. To use the paint bucket, click on the object while equipping the bucket and pick the texture of your choice. For more information on this tool, check PeacefulEnd's wiki [url=https://github.com/Floogen/AlternativeTextures/wiki/Paint-Bucket-Tool]here[/url]. [/size]

[size=4]THESE PLUSHIES REPLACE THE [color=#1e84cc][b]LARGE FUTAN BEAR.[/b][/color][/size]

[size=5]Installation: [/size]

[size=3]1. Install the latest version of [/size][url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI
[/url][size=3]2. Install the latest version of [/size][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]Alternative Textures[/url]
[size=3]3. Install the mod (manual download is recommended over vortex/mod managers)[/size]
[size=3]4. Unzip the file, place the folder in your Mods folder[/size]
[size=3]5. Launch your game and enjoy!  [/size]
